rules.method: Sun above/below horizon; Sun/Jupiter/Saturn diurnal, Moon/Venus/Mars nocturnal. Mercury uses morning/evening phase.
rules.author: Chris Brennan and guests
exceptions: Geometric center horizon threshold is explicit implementation convention; refraction, terrain and a solar-disk convention can change borderline sect.

rules.method: Morning Mercury diurnal; evening Mercury nocturnal.
rules.author: Robert Hand / Chris Brennan
exceptions: Hand also discusses an application-based alternative; not implemented. Longitude phase is computed, not actual visibility.

rules.method: Domicile, exaltation, triplicity, bounds and ten-degree faces are table lookups; debilities are detriment/fall.
rules.author: William Lilly; Skyscript presentation
rules.locator: Main dignity diagram and separate Egyptian terms diagram
exceptions: Egyptian and Lilly-Ptolemaic bounds remain distinct. Lilly's table is not identical to all Ptolemy transmissions. Exaltation degree is reported as data; dignity applies throughout its sign.

rules.method: Day/night priority rulers plus participating ruler; Lilly uses two rulers, with Mars ruling water in both sects.
rules.author: Deborah Houlding
rules.locator: Ancient Assignment of Triplicity Rulers; nocturnal Scorpio example
examples: Nocturnal Scorpio: Mars, Venus, Moon in priority order.
exceptions: Participating rulership is exposed separately; no universal dignity score.

rules.method: The dignity owner receives the visiting planet; mutual reception is reciprocal. Optional aspect-required rule uses sign configuration and major dignity or two minor dignities.
rules.author: Deborah Houlding
examples: Sun at 25 Libra at night: Venus domicile, Saturn exaltation, Mercury triplicity, Mars term, Jupiter face in Lilly tables.
exceptions: Occupancy, sign-level aspect-required reception and Hellenistic domicile dispositorship are separate policies. No claim to full Bonatti perfection rules.

rules.method: CA p.113: same-sign combustion below 8.5 degrees; beams below 17; cazimi within 17 arcminutes. Earlier beams convention: 15 degrees, without medieval combustion/cazimi categories.
rules.author: Skyscript glossary citing William Lilly
examples: Lilly: Sun 15°30 Taurus and Venus 15°25 Taurus is cazimi.
exceptions: Lilly p.300 instead uses 12-degree beams and 16-minute cazimi; this conflicting passage is recorded but not merged into CA113. No naked-eye visibility guarantee.

rules.method: Day Fortune ASC+Moon−Sun, Spirit ASC+Sun−Moon; reverse each at night.
rules.author: NCGR Geocosmic Journal contributors
rules.locator: The Hellenistic Lots: Fortune & Spirit, displayed formulas
exceptions: Fixed-day Fortune is a separate convention; Spirit remains sect-reversing. Lots are symbolic points, not physical bodies.

rules.method: Fortune uses ASC+Moon−Sun for day and night.
rules.author: William Lilly
rules.locator: p.143, Of the Part of Fortune, and how to take it, either by Day or Night
exceptions: Spirit is not attributed to Lilly here; its formula remains separately sourced.

procedures.method: Question is posed to astrologer, or letter opened and intent understood; not arrival/delivery time.
exceptions: Named understood-question protocol; caller supplies actual moment/location, never current clock automatically.

procedures.method: For advice intent erect the figure when adviser first begins disclosing their mind.
exceptions: Selected category overrides generic question-receipt protocol; advice-begins is mandatory.

procedures.method: ASC and ruler signify querent; select the relevant house of what is asked.
exceptions: Moon is co-significator per124. Advice p194 uses tenth-house occupants rather than treating its ruler as adviser by invention.

procedures.method: Traditional domiciles/exaltations, Lilly triplicities, Ptolemaic terms and faces.
exceptions: Reuse verified Lilly tables, not Hellenistic/modern substitutions.

procedures.method: Choose explicitly first-column orb diameters; moiety is half each planet's orb added. Application approaches exact aspect.
exceptions: First-column diameters Sun17,Moon12.5,Mercury7,Venus8,Mars7.5,Jupiter12,Saturn10; alternative column not merged.

procedures.method: Applying significators can be impeded by another body or aspect before their contact.
exceptions: p111 gives Sun6/Mars7/Saturn12 Aries example. Intervening geometry alone is a candidate, not universally an adverse judgment.

procedures.method: Applying planet turns retrograde before completing conjunction.
exceptions: Distinguish station geometry from causally certified cancellation.

procedures.method: Slower recipient joins another body before faster applicant reaches it.
exceptions: p113 Mercury10/Mars12/Jupiter13 Aries example; compare chronological solved contacts.

procedures.method: Third body separates from first significator (which receives it by domicile/triplicity/terms) then applies to second before another contact.
exceptions: p111 simpler example is preserved separately; reception-qualified p126 route not assumed from any two contacts.

procedures.method: Two principal significators not beholding each other cast aspects to a more weighty third, and both receive that collector in essential dignity.
exceptions: Requires specific receiving direction; no modern averaging or universal probability.

procedures.method: Moon makes no further application during its sign; cautions and Taurus/Cancer/Sagittarius/Pisces exceptions on122.
exceptions: Same-sign exact-contact proxy is explicitly computational; if entry-into-orb and exact-before-ingress disagree, withhold judgment.

procedures.method: Consider hour/ASC affinity; early/late ASC, late Moon/via combusta, Saturn1/7, combust ASC lord, afflicted seventh lord, conflicting testimonies.
exceptions: pp122–123 exceptions retained; conservative acceptance may withhold even when a historical exception might permit judgment.

procedures.method: Sun,Jupiter,Venus or North Node in tenth, OR Moon applying to ASC lord: favorable intent testimony.
exceptions: Intention only, not whether advice is correct or beneficial in actual outcomes.

procedures.method: Saturn,Mars or South Node in tenth: deceptive-intent testimony.
exceptions: No arbitrary weight; conflicting favorable testimony yields indeterminate.

procedures.method: ASC sign, ASC lord sign and Moon sign all movable: additional deceptive-intent testimony attributed by Lilly to Haly.
exceptions: Conflict with favorable testimony is exposed rather than priority invented.

procedures.method: Conjunction without prohibition/refranation; sextile/trine with dignity/good houses and no intervening malefic aspect; square/opp have extra conditions.
exceptions: General event-outcome doctrines kept diagnostic; advice-intent does not certify event success.

procedures.method: Sunrise begins weekday lord;12 unequal daylight and12 unequal night hours follow Saturn,Jupiter,Mars,Sun,Venus,Mercury,Moon cyclically.
exceptions: Source table arithmetic tested; current sunrise from explicit standard refraction/upper-limb model. Polar cases outside bounded domain.

procedures.method: Seventh-lord unfortunate/impeded caution is broader than retrograde/fall alone. Missing verified accidentals must withhold definitive classification.
exceptions: No arbitrary strength score; historical fixed-star longitudes cannot be reused unchanged at modern dates.
